pages.title: Three routes
pages.text:
**Goal:** seat any two of Clock, Swarm and Spark, then spin **Braid Cord** at the Post.\
You need two of those tokens seated, a **Strand Filament**, and a **Tension Post**.\
After Claw, three branches open together:\
**Pattern / Clock:** mechanical processing.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text:
**Colony / Swarm:** bees and their production chains.\
**Hum / Spark:** living power and workshops.\
A team can divide the work. You will still need all nine Strands for the final reweave.

pages.title: Make Braid Cord
pages.text:
1\. Check that two of Clock, Swarm and Spark are seated at your Post. Merely holding their tokens is not enough.\
2\. Hold a **Strand Filament**.\
3\. Right-click the Post to receive **Braid Cord**.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: Do not put tokens in a crafting grid. They record progress. If the Post refuses, read its message and check which Strands are seated.

pages.title: Check
pages.text: **Check:** two of those three notches are lit, and Braid Cord is in your hand. Next: Bind and the Sigil quests.
